title: Brief: the front matter of a work order's BRIEF.md
description: What a crew is given (build-way 3.7). The file is markdown with a front matter block, one 'key: value' per line; frontmatter.mjs turns it into this object. The body (goal, why, owned files, done-means, proof, stop-when) is for people.

decision.description: The answered decision for art and Board work (decide before build), or none for other work.

base.description: main, or a parent branch (stack depth at most 2; 0 for Board and art work).

budget.description: The crew's cap, in plain words (40 turns; 90 min).

depth.description: BRAIN_AGENT_DEPTH for the crew: how many levels of helpers it may start.
